description: Change the negativeVarColumn boundary check from > 0 to >= 0, causing incorrect basic row retrieval when the negative variable column is at index 0.
Change loop condition from i < coefficients.length to i <= coefficients.length, causing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Change colIndex check from < 0 to <= 0, causing decision variables at column index 0 to be treated as missing.
Change basicRow == 0 check to basicRow < 0, breaking the special handling for objective function row check.
Swap the subtraction operands for unconstrained variables when basicRows already contains the basicRow, subtracting mostNegative from 0 instead of subtracting it properly.
